title: Urysohn test function with ν(K) ≤ ofReal(∫ g dν) ≤ ν(O) for all locally finite ν
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let K ⊆ ℝ^N be compact and O ⊆ ℝ^N open with K ⊆ O. Then there is a continuous g : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ O such that ν(K) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(∫ g dν) ≤ ν(O) for every measure ν on ℝ^N with ν(L) < ∞ for every compact L ⊆ O. The same g works for all such ν.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (K O : Set (Euclidean N)), IsCompact K → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ∃ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ O ∧ ∀ ν : Measure (Euclidean N), (∀ L : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact L → L ⊆ O → ν L ≠ ∞) → ν K ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, g x ∂ν) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, g x ∂ν) ≤ ν O
